top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs two achievements that each meet my test of established structure and mechanism followed by a new capability. Pd-catalysed C-N coupling has a well-characterised catalytic cycle and ligand-structure to reactivity relationship, industrial use, and the cleanest attribution (Buchwald, Hartwig), with the Kosugi and Migita precedents and the 2010 overlap to be stated in the citation. Base editing with Liu alone is a chemically conceived capability that did not exist before 2016, reproduced widely and in clinical use; the Komor, Gaudelli, Kondo and Nishida contributions must be addressed explicitly in the citation. P002 is next because it keeps Liu alone with a degradation part (Crews, Handa) that is already medicine through cereblon glues; P004 follows as the single-part base-editing fallback with the evolved-TadA adenine editor credited.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no tie to Buchwald, Hartwig or Liu. Stockholm University colleague of Peter Brzezinski, which bears on no proposal. My porous-materials field relates only to B033, which is not on the slate.
